verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents user-controlled deletion through its write API: conditional deletes and delete-by-filter, which can remove sets of documents matching a condition (e.g., per-tenant or per-user data). The evidence says nothing about retention controls such as TTL/auto-expiry policies, configurable retention periods, or guarantees on purging data from object storage and backups after deletion, so only the deletion half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: retention/TTL policies, documented whole-namespace deletion, post-deletion purge or backup-retention guarantees, independent corroboration.
